methodology.within_family_measure: unweighted share of distinct relevant GlottoDelta languages in this unit attesting each target realization family
methodology.soft_measure: strict support plus the already-defined accent-tolerant soft-merger fallbacks
methodology.cross_family_F: calculated separately as a population-weighted aggregate of this unweighted within-family support
methodology.warning: phonemic inventory attestation is evidence about phonological category familiarity, not a complete model of allophonic production ability or learnability
methodology.source_inventory_limit: the frozen baseline exposes 111 tracked phoneme cells rather than complete upstream PHOIBLE inventories; absence can therefore include a nearby realization outside the tracked chart

analysis_order.note: used for analysis order and cross-family population weight; not used inside the unweighted within-family support denominator
